The '''Zakuul Hovercraft''' was a multi-purpose [[Repulsorcart/Legends|repulsorcart]] model used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. A number of Zakuul Hovercrafts were deployed during the [[Assault on Odessen]] in [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zakuul Hovercrafts appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during '''"Chapter VIII: End Times".''' They are also available as housing decorations from the Vigilant Defender Pack, which identifies them by name.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
